query:
SELECT pc.mes, pc.ano, pc.producaoTotal, pc.quantidadeVendida,
  (SELECT SUM(cs.totalGeral) FROM custo_setor cs WHERE cs.periodoCustoId = pc.id) as custoSetorTotal,
  (SELECT SUM(lc.valor) FROM lancamento_custo lc WHERE lc.periodoCustoId = pc.id) as lancamentoTotal
FROM periodo_custo pc
WHERE (pc.mes IN (2,3,4) AND pc.ano = 2026)
ORDER BY pc.mes;
